label: DoorDash Scraper
title: DoorDash Scraper: Stores, Menus, Fees & Reviews
metaDescription: Scrape DoorDash stores, full menus, featured items, delivery fees, pickup ETAs and customer reviews, with location-aware search and multi-URL input.
intro: Search DoorDash by location or paste store links and get store listings, full menus with prices, featured items, star distribution, delivery fees and pickup ETAs, with optional customer reviews.
useCases: Compare menu prices across restaurants in an area
Track delivery fees and ETAs by location
Research a cuisine's competition before opening

faq.q: Is there a DoorDash API for menus and stores?
faq.a: Not for public data. This actor returns stores, ratings, delivery fees and times, and full menus with prices for any DoorDash search or store link.

faq.q: Why do results depend on the address?
faq.a: DoorDash shows different stores, fees and times for each delivery address. Set the address in the input (default: downtown Chicago) to see what customers there see.

faq.q: Can I use it as a DoorDash API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: DoorDash search or store link
liveDemo.hint: Paste a DoorDash search or store link and press Run: the demo fetches the first stores live (up to 10). Delivery address: Chicago by default.

officialApi: DoorDash has no public API for store or menu data; its developer APIs are for merchants and delivery partners. This actor reads the public DoorDash search and store pages for a delivery address.
